children: Someit Sidhu, manager of JATT Ventures II L.P., disclosed a 23.1% stake in JATT II Acquisition Corp. The Schedule 13D was filed on Sep. 15, 2026 after the SPAC’s April 20, 2026 IPO and related sponsor purchases. The move formalizes control of founder and private placement shares and underscores his influence as the SPAC’s CEO.

Sidhu reports holding the shares "in support of the Issuer's business plan and for investment purposes." He currently has no separate agreements to buy more stock, but he may buy or sell in the future. The stake reflects founder shares acquired for $25,000 and 300,000 private placement shares purchased at the IPO, aligning the sponsor with the SPAC’s deal objectives.

As CEO, Sidhu says he is "actively involved in pursuing a suitable target for the Issuer's business combination" and will help execute any deal. A successful merger could bring changes to the board, corporate structure, or charter, giving him a central role in shaping the transaction and its aftermath for JATT II Acquisition Corp.

Someit Sidhu is the Chairman, Director, and Chief Executive Officer of JATT II Acquisition Corp. He manages JATT Ventures II L.P., the SPAC’s sponsor, and holds voting and dispositive power over its founder and private placement shares. Sidhu is a healthcare-focused entrepreneur and investor who has led SPAC initiatives and backed life sciences ventures with a hands-on operating approach.
